"ABI specification for REVERT reason string" PR 7186 (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/pull/7186) wants to create an EIP for ERC838 (https://github.com/ethereum/EIPs/issues/838) which only appeared to be an issue and revive the original number.

Anyone oppose reviving number 838?
